item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud glu ru'i thugs bcud las nyams khrid 'phrul mdzod zhu lan lnga pa drang nges lam gyi dbye ba bdud rtsi bcud ldan
item.coloph: nges don zab mo bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan 'di/ las ldan skyes mchog khyed kyi snyan du brgyud pa'o/ skal ldan snod dang skal med sde/ gsang sbas thabs mkhas rnal 'byor spyod par gyis/ sa ma yaH rgya rig 'dzin byang chub rdo rje'i gnas bya khri'i g.yas zur du bkod pa'o//
